name: Basic Piano Chords, Lessons 3-6
instructions: Continue today's chord series from where Day 5 left off, adding a few more common chords to your vocabulary.
Compare each new chord's hand shape to ones you already know -- many share a similar shape shifted to a different starting key.
Practice a simple progression using two or three of your chords in a row, in steady rhythm.
Watch lessons 3 through 6 of today's video series.
